translations.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
translations.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
translations.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah; he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
